fato_historico: 1917: The Russian Empire is formally replaced by the Russian Republic.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to embrace transition today, Libra. Just as empires shift into new republics, your personal world may be ready for a beautiful transformation. It is a good time to reconsider old structures in your life, letting go of what no longer serves your inner peace as you seek a harmonious, fresh beginning.
frase_do_dia: Every ending creates a sacred space for a beautiful new beginning to unfold.
significado_numero: Represents the dynamic energy of change and adaptability in your life.
conselho: Consider welcoming change with an open heart and a balanced, graceful spirit today.
